examples.text: Он стряхивает снег, распрямляется во весь рост, поднимает к небу свою зелёную, обледенелую, чуть рыжеватую хвою.

glosses: To become straight, or straighter.

examples.text:
2006, American Motoryclist - Jan 2006, Victory's Kingpin goes its own way
bank the big cruiser into the first of a series of corners, make a few quick left, right, left transitions, then the road straightens up for a stretch...

glosses: To steer straight.

examples.text:
13 October 2010, Blackpool Gazette, 'Bad driving' led to biker death crash
He said "As I came out of the bend I went to straighten up the car and it just seemed to be carrying on turning."

glosses: To sit up straight, to stop hunching.

examples.text: Horse skin smells good. Lay your cheek against his neck and have a good cuddle. Now straighten up slowly again, and sit loosely.

glosses: To deal with; to put in order.

examples.text:
1994, Mccook Daily Gazette, Jul 12, 1994, Mail Delivery Trying To Get Up To Speed
The Postal Service sent a special task force to straighten up the city's problems with a back-to-basics approach

glosses: To tidy; to tidy up.

examples.text: The lockers were all standing wide open with equipment and uniforms scattered all over the room, he had left a note under the bottle telling me to straighten up the room, then straighten myself up before coming to work the next day.

glosses: To clarify.
To start living a reformed life; to adopt a more honest and respectable course of behavior.

glosses: To remove a bend so as to make, or allow to become, straight.

examples.text: He leant tensely against the corridor wall and frowned like a man trying to unbend a corkscrew by telekinesis.

glosses: To release (a load) from a strain or from exertion; to set at ease for a time; to relax.

examples.text: You do unbend your noble strength.
to unbend the mind from study or care

glosses: To unfasten sails from the spars or stays to which are attached for use.
To cast loose or untie
To cease to be bent; to become straight.
To relax in exertion, attention, severity, or the like

examples.text: He spent the afternoon shaping a swagger-stick from the branch of jarrah and talking with Miss La Rue, who had sufficiently unbent toward him to notice his existence.

glosses: to enjoy oneself; to become affable and free from formality
